row.body: The bar’s entertainment list is clipped to a water check for the back room; the beverage delivery was marked complete before the door was opened.
row.title: Friday’s entertainment

sidecar.gloss: The back-room water check and bar delivery are recorded out of order.
sidecar.rival_reading: An emergency team could test a room and receive drinks during a response; the records do not say what prompted the check.
